catalog.name: IWMI Water Accounting (WA+)
catalog.description: Water Accounting Plus outputs from the IWMI Data Cube: rainfall, evapotranspiration, runoff and water yield per basin/country, split by season and annual totals. Generated by scripts/generate-water-accounting-init.mjs from the explorer's STAC API. Values are millimetres (float32, nodata -9999). These are not on the workbench by default — open a basin and pick a layer.

members.name: Zambezi basin (2003)
members.description: Water accounting for the Zambezi basin at ~1104 m: rainfall, total ET, green and blue ET, water yield and runoff, each as a yearly average and split into dry and wet seasons, averaged over 2003-2021. Water Accounting Plus output rebuilt from IWMI's Africa GeoPortal tile services, which serve no downloadable raster.
